main_text.p: Quia sensus reclamat: potis ille est Philomangones exolvere sacramento: At vero adversum clamores ejus aurem obturabant alibi, cur hic non item? Quia hic vocalis nimium est, & ingenti, quidquid aures opplet, pertundit boatu: Si ergo non altum, increpet, si non stentori is clamoribus objurget ille Censor, putant rem salvam esse, bene geri omnia? Alias raucus est, diutinâ cum surdastris vociferatione, alias hebes, alias caecutit & delirat ipse: Quid ergo? Capio: Errare non recusant: quin immo formosos istos errores suaviari cupiunt, ita dulces viden-

page.notes: The facing right page is only partly visible and too faint to read reliably; no margin notes were transcribed. Catchword and signature are not visible. Possible misreadings: "Philomangones" and "boatu" as printed; "viden-" is the line-end word, continued on the next page.
